decision: gate retained; fixed missing ChunkMasking body support
head: 128d71757984263e89e53c216b1ef8f0153ec2b7
result: exact 21-byte body through SOCKS5 -> sing-box VMess -> netz server -> HTTP target for all four combinations
bug_found: src/proxy/vmess/body.zig implemented the VMess header AEAD but only the unmasked legacy stream-body format. sing-box sets option bit 4 (ChunkMasking), so the 2-byte length is XORed with SHAKE128 output and the server misread the first body chunk. Added masked encryptor/decryptor and zero-length termination handling; also sized the plaintext chunk buffer for maximum-size peer chunks and fixed latent server compile errors.
